title: smilax hastata var. lanceolata
intro: Smilax hastata var. lanceolata, commonly known as Greenbrier, is a type of flowering plant in the Smilacaceae family. It is native to eastern North America and is known for its medicinal properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Greenbrier include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
